assets.prompt:
Create a professional production-ready TRANSPARENT PNG modular pixel-avatar component atlas. Reference image 1 is the existing kit; reference image 2 is its composed in-app appearance. MATCH that compact, friendly, restrained pixel-game style exactly, with chunky tiny pixel clusters, dark muted outlines, 3-4 flat shade levels, no realistic face or fabric details. This is an EXPANSION of the existing paper-doll kit, not a character illustration. All pieces must fit the same large round head and short chibi body, facing almost front with a very slight rightward turn as in reference. Exactly 25 SEPARATE standalone wearable components, arranged as 5 evenly spaced columns and 5 rows on fully transparent background. Each part centered inside its cell, ample transparent gutters, no touching neighboring cells. NO people, NO faces, NO skin, NO mannequins, NO arms or hands, NO feet, NO labels or text or grid lines, NO shadows behind the pieces. Hair is a hollow wearable WIG with transparent empty face/ear region, no skin pixels whatsoever. Tops have complete long sleeves angled down/out like the reference, ending at wrists with empty cuffs and open neck; render collars/clothing, never a neck/head. Bottoms have two short leg openings or leggings, no shoes or feet. Hats are standalone headwear. Accessories are front-view wearable parts with their straps/loops but no person. Keep outlines and proportions compatible with the reference; clean usable silhouettes, not noisy painted art. Render all 25 requested pieces fully within the canvas with true alpha.
